_meta.screen_of_world: sx = X0 + (c - r) * 32 ; sy = Y0 + (c + r) * 16 - z   (px at 1x; z up in px)
_meta.anchor_rule: image top-left = P(c, r) - anchor, where (c, r) = min corner (north vertex) of the footprint. Wall items: R -> P(c0, 0), L -> P(0, r0).
_meta.depth_rule: objects: key = c + r + depth_offset.back ; front slice: c + r + depth_offset.front ; avatar: pos.c + pos.r + 0.05 ; draw ascending
layer_order: objects/back slices + avatars + front slices (depth sorted)
glow layers (screen, same anchor as object)
_meta.floor_note: v1.2 floors: every room is night navy (walnut for library) with a low-contrast 2-value check; carpet_* / floor_gallery are navy tinted 12% toward the room accent. Same ids/anchors as v1.1. grass_* is a legacy saturated tile, not recommended for room floors.

v13.seats_extra: seats[].pose = "lie" (loungers): anims ["lie"], lie_seat_z_px; high_stool seat_z_px 26 -> avatar_offset_y_px -12
v13.chair_slots: meeting_table_teal_*: chair_slots[] = 6 chair cells (relative to the table origin) + chair id + seat point/facing
v13.swim: water cells: pool_water (floor, 4 frames @180 ms + glow) carry zone="swim", water_surface_z_px, water_line_px, swim_avatar_offset_y_px; pool_edge_*/pool_corner_*/pool_inner_* are coping overlays drawn on water cells
